verdict.rationale: Washington SOS's own pages link to online versions of its core business-entity transactions: "Register a Foreign (Non-WA) Limited Liability Company (LLC) Online," "Close a Corporation Online," and an "Express Annual Report," alongside a "Start a Domestic (WA) Business" entry point. The in-person counter is framed as a paid same-day fallback, which implies online filing is the default channel. The DOR business-license pages belong to a different agency and were not credited. missing for 10: explicit statement that domestic (WA) entity formation itself is filed online, documentation of online fee payment, and hands-on or independent corroboration (evidence is mostly link titles).
